description: The Reader asked back for works 4 times and the report cannot say what works weighs: the answer asks for works first and changes nothing; after the app sends it (a short digest) the second answer puts works on the Reader's list.

catalogue.name: add-word
catalogue.tell: Adds a word (its lemma) to his words to learn; undoable

catalogue.name: progress
catalogue.tell: where he stands: the learner line (solid words, learning, due) and his grammar (goal, counts, suggested move)

catalogue.name: reader
catalogue.tell: Opens the Reader

catalogue.name: rusty-words
catalogue.tell: the solid words and ideas he now slips on or has been away from, worst first

catalogue.name: set-setting
catalogue.tell: Changes a setting; the app can undo it

catalogue.name: settings
catalogue.tell: what every setting holds now

catalogue.name: start-review
catalogue.tell: Opens Review; with items (from rusty-words) moves them to Frontier and practises just them

catalogue.name: today-drill
catalogue.tell: the items of today's drill (the Today chip), each with its title and whether he ticked it

catalogue.name: where-he-is
catalogue.tell: the screen he is on, the chapter and verse in the Reader, the sheets open

catalogue.name: words-screen
catalogue.tell: Opens Words

catalogue.name: works
